svg.title: Quickstart
svg.desc: Three steps: 1 copy AGENTS.md, 2 fill your project block, 3 done. Claude Code also needs CLAUDE.md. When: a new project, or an agent repeats a mistake. Works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
